Grace,

Thanks for taking point. Given the details (120m outage; dedicated reserved capacity; verified root cause and that it was within our control), I approve moving forward with the standard contract calculation and issuance. Finance: please prepare a credit memo equal to the pro-rated amount per the SLA below.

Calculation guidance for the team (use for transparency in the customer-facing note):
- total_minutes = 30 days * 24 * 60 = 43,200
- allowed_downtime = total_minutes * (1 - 0.9995) = 21.6 minutes
- outage_minutes = 120
- minutes_beyond_SLA = max(0, outage_minutes - allowed_downtime) = 98.4
- credit_percent = minutes_beyond_SLA / total_minutes = 98.4 / 43,200 = 0.2277%
- credit_amount = credit_percent * monthly_committed_spend

Rounded example (if monthly_committed_spend = $65,000):
- credit_amount ≈ 0.002277 * 65,000 ≈ $148.00 (rounded)

Note: the contract also contains a discrete credit banding table for larger outages (>= 240m, >= 720m) that escalates to % tiers (5%, 15%, etc.). This one falls under the pro-rata minute-based calculation per section 4.2. Approve issuance of credit memo; have Finance apply to the next invoice.

-Marcus
VP Customer Success, Redwood Inference
